question: What is realized when the domain of division is pacified in the supreme teaching?
premises: The supreme teaching states that one who knows thus knows in truth.
This knowledge arises in the yoga of realization.
In that yoga the sphere of division becomes quieted.
inference: True knowledge in the supreme doctrine consists in realization when division is pacified.
plain_english: Thus it is said in the supreme doctrine: one who knows in this way knows in truth; for in the yoga of realization, when the sphere of division is quieted, this is understood.
